entities.summary: Rhydderch Hael, Riderch I of Alt Clut, or Rhydderch of Strathclyde, or Redrath was a ruler of Alt Clut, a Brittonic kingdom in the Hen Ogledd or "Old North" of Britain. He was one of the most famous kings in the Hen Ogledd, and appears frequently in later medieval works in Welsh and Latin.
